MPDANTIC.SAVED: Saved. The core is being restarted.
MPDANTIC.MGMT_SECTION_DESC: MPDantic's own pages, served by its core on this player and announced on the network as MPDantic on this player's name. Open them from here, or from any browser on the network at the address below.
MPDANTIC.MGMT_PORT_DESC: The port the pages are served on, 1024 to 65535.
MPDANTIC.MGMT_ADDRESS_DESC: The host name or IP address browsers reach this player by. Empty uses the one found on the player's own network interface, shown here.
MPDANTIC.OPEN_HERE_DESC: MPDantic's pages inside this page, with the arrow back.
MPDANTIC.OPEN_TAB: Open the pages in a tab
MPDANTIC.OPEN_TAB_DESC: MPDantic's pages in a tab of their own, for a second screen or a phone:
MPDANTIC.BUFFER_SECTION_DESC: MPD holds each reply to Volumio in a buffer of at most this size and drops the connection past it, which is how the album list of a large library comes up empty. MPDantic sizes it to what this player's memory and Volumio's backend can take, through Volumio's own MPD configuration, so it survives every rewrite. A mitigation for large libraries, not a cure.
MPDANTIC.BUFFER_AUTO: Size the output buffer to this player
MPDANTIC.BUFFER_RAISED: Set to {{mib}} MiB (Volumio's own is {{floor}} MiB), bounded by {{limit}}: {{mem}} GB of memory, a backend heap of {{heap}} MiB.
MPDANTIC.BUFFER_FLOOR: Volumio's own {{floor}} MiB stands, bounded by {{limit}}: with {{mem}} GB of memory and a backend heap of {{heap}} MiB this player can take no larger reply.
MPDANTIC.BUFFER_MPD_OLD: Not set: MPD {{version}} takes no second value for a setting (0.21.19 or later does).
MPDANTIC.BUFFER_MPD_UNKNOWN: Not set: MPD's version could not be read.
MPDANTIC.LIMIT_TIME: the time the backend takes to read a reply
MPDANTIC.BUFFER_APPLIED: The output buffer is set; MPD is restarting.
MPDANTIC.ERR_MPD: MPD's configuration could not be rewritten: {{error}}
MPDANTIC.STATUS_UP: Core {{version}} is up; the pages are on port {{port}}. Output buffer: {{buffer}}
MPDANTIC.ERR_CORE: The core could not be started: {{error}}
MPDANTIC.ERR_PORT: Not a port: {{value}}. Use a number from 1024 to 65535.
MPDANTIC.ERR_ADDRESS: Not an address: {{value}}. A host name or an IP address, or empty.
MPDANTIC.MB_SECTION_DESC: Release lookups for tagging. By default the public MusicBrainz site is used at one request per second. A local mirror removes that limit when you run one; the URL is only used when the switch is on.
MPDANTIC.MB_MIRROR_DESC: Off: musicbrainz.org. On: the URL below. Save before the pages pick up a change.
MPDANTIC.MB_URL_DESC: Base address of the mirror, for example http://192.168.1.10:5000. A trailing /ws/2 is optional.
MPDANTIC.MB_TEST_DESC: Ask the mirror for a tiny release search and show whether it answered.
MPDANTIC.ERR_MB_URL: Not a mirror URL: {{value}}. Use http:// or https:// and a host.
